sections.presenting_complaint: Dysuria and urinary frequency for 3 days.
sections.history: Dysuria and frequency (about every 30 minutes) since Saturday. Possible pink-tinged urine this morning. Reports loin pain and fever; no rigors, nausea or vomiting. No vaginal discharge or itch. One previous UTI two years ago, treated with antibiotics (agent unknown). No known renal disease.
sections.medications_allergies: Vitamin D (winter). No known drug allergies.
sections.examination: Telephone consultation; not examined. Speaking in full sentences and sounds well.
sections.impression: Lower urinary tract infection (cystitis). Possible early pregnancy, to be excluded.
sections.plan: Nitrofurantoin 100 mg modified-release four times daily for 7 days. Pregnancy test today. Urine sample for culture before starting antibiotics. Call back tomorrow with pregnancy test result; if positive, face-to-face review and plan revised. Fluids and paracetamol; avoid ibuprofen until pregnancy excluded.
sections.safety_netting: Call the practice (or 111 out of hours) immediately if loin pain, fever, rigors or vomiting. Call back if not improving within 48 hours of starting antibiotics or worsening.
